title: MUBENCH: Assessment of Multilingual Capabilities of Large Language Models Across 61 Languages
reasoning: The paper uses religion and cultural specificities as criteria for a 'cultural sensitivity check' to identify and filter out potentially biased or Western-centric content from the benchmark. It evaluates how an LLM (GPT-4o) identifies these religious and cultural topics, but it does not benchmark the models on their religious knowledge, moral reasoning, or ethical frameworks as a primary task.
